scripts.start: npm run reset && docker run -p 8080:8000 -v $(pwd)/demo_project:/app/demo_project mcp-deadcode-analyzer
scripts.tools: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method":"tools/list"}' || echo 'Сервер не запущен (8080)'
scripts.dry-run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"full_cleanup","dryRun":true}}' || echo 'Сервер не запущен (8080)'
scripts.cleanup: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"full_cleanup"}}' || echo 'Сервер не запущен (8080)'
scripts.full: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.reset: docker stop $(docker ps -q 2>/dev/null || true) && docker rm $(docker ps -aq 2>/dev/null || true)
